title: Insight 1: Nov 1 ride brushed threshold ceiling
description: Your Nov 1 ride averaged 158 bpm, just 1 beat below your Z2 ceiling (159 bpm), with max HR hitting 195 bpm. Consider keeping easy rides truly easy by targeting ≤150 bpm to preserve recovery.

title: Insight 2: Nov 12 long ride carried high vertical load
description: The Nov 12 ride packed 506 m of climbing into 2 hours (≈250 m/h), the steepest rate in your recent block. On rolling terrain, that adds muscular fatigue — enjoy the hills but spin easier on climbs next time.

title: Insight 3: Five rides in eight days flags recovery sequencing risk
description: From Nov 5–12 you rode five times (≈every 1.6 days). Your readiness dropped to 67 and HRV to 57 on Nov 11. Insert a rest day or a very easy spin after two consecutive ride days.

title: Insight 4: Cycling progression — VO₂max 50, FTP ~213 W
description: Garmin VO₂max rose to 50 on Nov 12, and your best 20‑min power (224 W) suggests FTP around 213 W. That’s a solid gain since restart — keep enjoying the upward trend without chasing numbers.

title: Insight 5: Zone model check — HR and power zones aligned?
description: Your HR zones (LTHR 175) and power zones (FTP 213 W) come from different sources. A short ramp test would confirm whether 160 W (power Z3) matches 159 bpm (HR Z3) for you.

title: Insight 6: Polarized 80/20 — time in zone suggests ~75/25
description: Most rides sit in HR Z2 (avg 135–158 bpm) with only brief Z4/Z5 spikes. That’s close to 80/20; try making one weekly ride deliberately easy (Z1 only) and one with 3×5 min at 110% FTP to sharpen the split.

title: Insight 7: Recovery warning — readiness 67, HRV 57, sleep <5 h
description: Nov 11–12 wellness shows readiness 67, HRV 57 ms, and only 5 h 30 min sleep. Your body is asking for a pause — skip the next scheduled ride or do a 30‑min coffee spin at <130 bpm.

title: Insight 8: Strength — maximal power strong (10 s up to 981 W)
description: Your 10‑second peak hit 981 W on Nov 5 and 579 W on Nov 8. That’s plenty of sprint punch for fun rides. Maintain with occasional 10‑sec sprints every 2 weeks — no gym needed.

title: Insight 9: VO₂max booster — add 3×3 min at 115% FTP
description: To nudge VO₂max above 50, try a ride with 3×3 min at ~245 W (115% of 213 W) with 3 min easy spin between. Do this once a week on a fresh day, keep it playful.

title: Insight 10: FTP suggestion — test or use 20‑min field test
description: Current FTP 213 W is 95% of your best 20‑min effort (224 W on Nov 12). A proper 20‑min all‑out test (or a 5‑min + 20‑min protocol) would give a cleaner number than the stale 271 W from Garmin.
